exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (early and late onset)
cohort: 517 pregnant women who underwent planned cesarean section from the Diamater cohort study.
finding: While prepregnancy BMI was the only independent factor associated with postpartum urinary incontinence overall, early-onset gestational diabetes mellitus was a significant risk factor among women with a prepregnancy BMI > 25.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean section was the delivery method for all participants.
